artists.source_line: Jazzy Cubango and Fred Maestro are proud to announce the 14TH PARIS KIZOMBA CONGRESS. ★★★ THE BIGGEST KIZOMBA

features.rationale: The description states that more than 40 hours of workshops are part of the congress.
A separate social room is listed alongside the main dancefloor, so there is more than one dance room.
A pre-party before the main event is explicitly listed.
Three themed parties during the weekend are announced.

features.quote: Hotels near the festival from November 19 to 23, 2026
features.rationale: A list of recommended hotels near the festival with negotiated dates is given, and the pass is not stated to include accommodation.
